exposure: Received RBC transfusion vs. did not receive RBC transfusion
cohort: 350 obstetrics patients who had RBC crossmatch requests
finding: The mean C:T ratio was high (3.1), and factors such as Caesarean section, low hemoglobin levels, high estimated blood loss, and symptomatic anemia were significantly associated with RBC transfusion.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was significantly associated with RBC transfusion (p=0.011).
